executionPlan: Reran typecheck, lint, tests and builds myself (online and with network denied, in copies). Served the production build and the 729f9d6 baseline build on separate ports. Ran my own CDP probes on real-GPU headless Chrome with throwaway profiles that were deleted. Mutation-tested the camera fix in a temp copy. Cleaned up all copies, servers and profiles.
summary: Rejected on one visible defect. During the landing crouch after a jump next to a Lab wall, the head bone sinks up to 0.19 m inside the wall for 12 to 24 frames, and the screenshot shows the head hidden in the wall. This happened in 3 of 4 runs of the Lab left-wall scenario, so the hedge and wall head-clearance fix is incomplete. F-M3-1 is fixed, and the lamp, Experience panel, hair halo, type check and gate fixes hold. The round-1 checks cut off by the disk, and the regression suite, all pass.

criteria.criterion: F-M3-1 is confirmed fixed with QA's own probes on the production build: with the avatar pressed against the tower passage walls, the outer Lab wall and at least three other walls QA chooses, a full 360 degree yaw sweep at both pitch limits gives 0 frames with the camera inside a collider, below the ground, inside the avatar, or with the head or torso hidden, and the earlier drop, passage, stairs and pitch scenarios stay clean; the new pocket tests fail with the old pullIn behaviour in a temp copy.
criteria.evidence: 8 wall-hug scenarios, 12 or more distinct walls touched (list in testsRun), about 1300 frames each at all pitch phases: inside 0, head occluded 0, torso occluded 0 (probe at the design height of 1.2 m), minCamY at least 0.2, camera to avatar at least 0.797 m. Passage, plaza pitch and drop runs are clean. Mutation: 21 of 90 followCamera tests fail with the swing search removed and the forced minDistance restored. Reverting only the final line fails 0 tests, an equivalent mutant outside sealed pockets. One caveat: a probe at the lower Spine bone (1.08 m) saw the torso line blocked on 12 of 519 frames by a low Lab plinth at the lowest pitch. The head and chest stayed visible, so I do not count it (below the design's 1.2 m guarantee).

criteria.criterion: The smaller fixes hold: no visible head or body penetration into the hedge or walls on jumps (head bone clearance per frame), no lamp filling the foreground on the main routes, the Experience panel reads cleanly with only persona content, and the hair shows no halo in top-down, side and behind views at idle and walk while the hero hair is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: Head penetration is NOT fixed for building walls. On the Lab left wall (lab-side-l, inner face), jumping while pressed against it gives a head bone 0.19 m inside the wall for 12 to 24 frames in 3 of 4 runs, during the landing crouch (pen-lab-side-l-inner.jpg, hedge.mjs). The hedges are clean (Head min 0.32 to 0.53 m). The other walls tested stay positive, 0.083 to 0.115 m. Passed: lamps (r2-workshop and r2-lab route shots, lamp-sheet.jpg); Experience panel (panel-workshop-experience.png, every line found in persona data except the heading, close button and 'Education and certifications' label); hair halo (r2vis-sheet.png, no halo or specks at idle, pitch, top-down, side, behind and walk); hero hair unchanged (herocmp pixel comparison).

criteria.criterion: Every finding is reported with file, line, severity, trigger, consequence, evidence and rule, and the verdict is approved only if every criterion above passed; Boss-accepted items recorded in work-item.json decisions are reported but are not grounds for rejection unless QA finds them visibly wrong.

assumptions: Torso line of sight is judged at the design height of 1.2 m above the soles (CAMERA.losHeights); a lower Spine-bone probe was recorded as information only.
The no-WebGL failure state is Play disabled with no dialog, per design.md line 582 and R4; no dialog is expected.
The failures-all network scenario is not applicable to this build because its chunk name is hardcoded, so the clips scenario covers the download failure.
cam-blocks.json regenerated from the working tree and identical to round 1, since the collision standoff changes the physics collider only and not the camera blocker data.
decisionsProposed: Route F-M3-2 to the Milestone 3 game-dev for a fix round: make the landing crouch pose or the wall standoff keep the head bone at least 0.12 m outside every wall. Options are a bigger standoff or a lean limit that scales with distance to the wall. Add a test that jumps and lands pressed against lab-side-l, lab-side-r and lab-back and checks head bone clearance on every frame of the landing, not only the jump pose.
Keep the camera pocket test and add the equivalent-mutant note: the final max() line is only load-bearing in a sealed pocket.
lessonsProposed: F-M3-2 (medium, round 2). File: components/game/world/campus.ts line 19 (WALL_STANDOFF 0.15) with components/game/world/colliders.ts line 22 (standoff on the collider). Trigger: jump repeatedly pressed against the inner face of the Lab left wall (lab-side-l), diagonal to the wall. Consequence: during the landing crouch the head is 0.5 m ahead of the capsule and 0.19 m inside the wall for 12 to 24 frames, with only hair visible above the wall surface. Evidence: hedge.mjs run output and pen-lab-side-l-inner.jpg. Rule: the avatar's head and body never visibly penetrate level geometry when jumping or walking into it. The dev measured the jump pose on the hedges and two other boundaries but not the landing crouch on building walls.

Probe harnesses must put the Chrome profile inside the stage output directory and delete it on close, exit and failure. The round-1 h.mjs wrote profiles to the session temp root and never deleted them. The patched h.mjs left 0 profile directories, and free disk stayed between 21 and 25 GB.
